description: Adversaries may use internal spearphishing to gain access to additional information or exploit another user, system, or service within the compromised environment. Internal spearphishing is multi-staged campaign where an email account is owned either by controlling the user's device or by compromising the account credentials of the user. Adversaries attempt to take advantage of a trusted internal account to increase the likelihood of tricking the target into falling for the attack.

falco.trigger_condition: Emails sent from a compromised internal account to other internal users with suspicious attachments or links. Detection primarily at the email gateway layer; Falco can only detect post-exploitation process behaviors inside containers after the user takes the bait.

mitigation: Apply behavioral email filtering on internal mail flows. Implement DMARC to prevent internal impersonation. Educate users about internal phishing threats. Monitor mailbox access from unusual locations or at unusual hours.
